incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: ModelCatalogService autopromote job promoted an unexpected revision for model 'rw-text-13b' -> tokenizer mismatch and generation errors observed. PD incident ID: PD-83421

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-83421 created and routed to eng-oncall primary. Escalation policy: oncall-primary -> oncall-secondary in 5m.

alice: ack. i'll take it. looking at error rates now. what scope do we have?

alice: quick metric check 
```
errors: 5xx for /v1/generate (rw-text-13b): baseline 0.3% -> 6.8% over last 7m
p95 latency up ~120ms
affected clusters: us-east-1a, eu-west-1
```

bob: ugh, that sounds like the autopromote we ran last night. I added a note about tokenizer version mismatch in the promotion job but it still ran.

alice: can someone dump the catalog entry? running API query now.

alice: output from catalog API:
```
GET /catalog/models/rw-text-13b
{
  "routes": [
    {"revision":"rev-20240409-7","tokenizer_version":"v2-tokenizer"},
    {"revision":"rev-20240214-9","tokenizer_version":"v1-tokenizer","pinned":true}
  ],
  "default_revision":"rev-20240409-7",
  "autopromote_enabled":true
}
```

charlie: that default_revision looks wrong — rev-20240409-7 uses v2-tokenizer while production runtime expects v1-tokenizer. That mismatch will cause decode errors when KV cache / tokenizer in serving runtime expect different token ids.

alice: ok mitigation plan: 1) disable autopromote 2) pin traffic back to rev-20240214-9 3) set fallback variant to quantized compatible build 4) monitor metrics and customer errors

bob: +1. we should do steps in that order. i'll prepare the command to disable autopromote.

bob: disable autopromote command:
```
POST /internal/catalog/admin/disable_autopromote
{"model":"rw-text-13b"}
```

incident-bot: autopromote disabled for rw-text-13b by bob (action id: act-9981)

alice: pinning route to rev-20240214-9 now.

alice: update route command:
```
PATCH /catalog/models/rw-text-13b/route
{"default_revision":"rev-20240214-9","force_pin":true}
```

incident-bot: route update accepted (job id: route-772). Deploy worker started.

alice: worker logs show rollout complete, traffic shifted. sample log:
```
[2024-04-09T15:34:12Z] route-772: 100% traffic -> rev-20240214-9 in cluster us-east-1a
[2024-04-09T15:34:15Z] healthcheck passed: rev-20240214-9
```

alice: errors dropping. 5xx back to ~0.6% over last 3m. p95 latency normalizing.

maya: good containment. we need to notify support and customers affected and create a postmortem. also a followup to ensure autopromote checks for tokenizer_version equality.

frank-cs: how many customers impacted? any high-tier customers?

alice: preliminary: ~24 customers had transient 502/500 on generate calls (high proportion were bursty test accounts). no enterprise SLAs missed yet; still validating. i'll follow up with precise list from logs.

bob: I opened a ticket INF-2345 to prevent autopromote when tokenizer_version != runtime_expected_tokenizer. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345

charlie: also adding a safeguard: runtime will now fallback to compatible quantized variant if decode errors > threshold. pushing a short patch.

alice: applied the fallback and disabled autopromote; monitoring looks stable. initiating customer outreach via CS. action items:
- CS to message affected customers (frank)
- SRE/infra to add token-version checks to autopromote (bob/charlie)
- Eng to create postmortem and root cause (maya/alice)

frank-cs: will draft outreach note and ping legal if messaging needed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-83421 marked acknowledged by alice. Escalation timer reset.

alice: handing off to eve for the next 2h watch — everything mitigated but want one more observation window.

eve: taking handoff. monitoring dashboards open. please ping if errors reappear.

alice: handoff summary: autopromote promoted rev-20240409-7 (tokenizer v2) into production while runtime expecting v1 tokens -> decode errors. mitigated by disabling autopromote and pinning to rev-20240214-9. error rates back near baseline. CS will contact impacted customers. JIRA INF-2345 opened. postmortem will be posted in incidents channel. //alice :white_check_mark:

charlie: after-action note: add unit test in autopromote integration tests that verifies tokenizer_version parity and that promotion jobs abort if mismatch.

maya: thanks everyone. i'll own the postmortem follow-up and assign owners for remediation.

alice: closing my active work here. leaving notes in the incident ticket.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 status: acknowledged -> resolved (resolved by alice).

alice: resolving thread. will add timeline and logs to the postmortem doc later.
